operations.details: Verified official OGC API - Tiles standard page.
Separated map/image tiles from vector and coverage tile semantics.
Tile level and matrix position not promoted to native terrain measurement resolution.
Tiled coverage still requires source survey, datum and raster lineage.
Verified official OGC SensorThings API standard page.
Observation transport model separated from sensor measurement accuracy.
SensorThings conformance not promoted to GNSS or LiDAR vertical accuracy.
IoT observation identity not substituted for HMLR parcel identity or boundary evidence.
Both OGC URLs are distinct from increments 069-122 source candidates.
No tile or IoT observation value substituted for official parcel results.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher still required.
